title: Ensure automation server is running during voyage
description: All skeleton tools depend on Ixdar automation server on port 47832. Voyage loop never starts or checks it. Add a health check at voyage start and optionally auto-launch via mvn -P mesh-viewer. If server is unavailable, skeleton tools fail silently. At minimum log a warning, ideally start the server as a subprocess.
definition-of-done: Voyage loop checks automation server health at startup. If unavailable, either auto-launches it or logs a clear warning. Skeleton tools work during voyage runs.
testing-plan: Start a voyage run without automation server running. Verify it either auto-starts or prints a clear warning about skeleton tools being unavailable.
